description: This file defines data structures and functions related to configuring a gateway, including loading configuration data from a JSON file, parsing various fields, and representing the configuration with includes for optional and required parameters.

classes.name: GatewayConfig
classes.description: A data structure holding the configuration parameters for the gateway including mode, binding address, port, remote URL, tokens, and passwords.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A data structure representing an endpoint with URL, token, password, and mode.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON configuration file to produce a GatewayConfig instance with settings for the gateway.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts various potential input types (Int, Double, String) into an optional Int value.
